events.subtitle: Kind of Grunge
events.category: Grunge-to-jazz reinterpretation / current album project / Tokyo club performance
events.factual_description: Blue Note Tokyo presents Ulysses Owens Jr. & Generation Y on September 25-26, 2026 with the current Kind of Grunge project. On September 25 the sets start at 18:00 and 20:30; on September 26 they start at 16:30 and 19:30. The venue lists Ulysses Owens Jr. on drums, Anthony Hervey on trumpet, Erena Terakubo on alto saxophone, Tyler Bullock on piano and Thomas Milovac on bass, with a music charge of ¥9,500. Kind of Grunge was released August 14, 2026; the project grew from Owens's Drumeo first-listen encounter with Nirvana's In Bloom into an album of grunge reinterpretations including material associated with Nirvana, Pearl Jam, Alice in Chains, Soundgarden, Stone Temple Pilots and others. The album sessions and the announced Tokyo live personnel are not identical, so only the Blue Note Tokyo lineup is recorded as the live lineup here.

The page exposes online reservations through its session-based booking interface rather than a stable event-specific public purchase URL, so no generic reservation destination is substituted. An exact Apple Music album destination for Kind of Grunge is verified.

en.why_it_matters: The hook is what the band is doing to the repertoire, not the novelty of a jazz group covering rock. Kind of Grunge grew from a first-listen improvisation into a full project that treats Nirvana, Pearl Jam, Soundgarden and their peers as material to be reharmonized, re-grooved and pulled into a road-tested jazz language. The Tokyo lineup adds Erena Terakubo on alto to that current project, giving the date a specific Japanese live connection rather than merely importing the record to Aoyama.
en.trip_verdict: If September 25-26 overlaps a Tokyo stay, actively make room for one of the four sets and let Aoyama anchor that part of the evening. Two nights provide enough flexibility for the performance to shape a Tokyo itinerary without making it the sole reason for a dedicated Japan trip.

es.why_it_matters: El gancho está en lo que la banda hace con el repertorio, no en la simple novedad de que un grupo de jazz toque rock. Kind of Grunge nació de una improvisación a primera escucha y terminó convertido en un proyecto completo que toma a Nirvana, Pearl Jam, Soundgarden y sus contemporáneos como material para reharmonizar, cambiar de groove y llevar al lenguaje de una banda de jazz ya curtida en vivo. La formación de Tokio suma a Erena Terakubo en alto, así que la fecha tiene además una conexión japonesa concreta y no se limita a trasladar el disco a Aoyama.
es.trip_verdict: Si el 25 o 26 de septiembre coincide con una estancia en Tokio, sí le haría espacio activamente a uno de los cuatro sets y dejaría que Aoyama ordene esa parte de la noche. Dos fechas dan suficiente flexibilidad para que el concierto moldee el itinerario en Tokio sin convertirlo en la única razón para organizar un viaje dedicado a Japón.

events.subtitle: Drums / keys-synth duo
events.category: Drums + keys/synth duo / NYC-Tokyo cross-current / jazz-hip-hop-electronic
events.factual_description: Blue Note Tokyo presents Jharis Yokley + BIGYUKI as a duo on Tuesday, September 29, 2026. The first set starts at 18:00 and the second at 20:30. The venue lists only Yokley on drums and BIGYUKI on keyboards and synthesizer, with a music charge of ¥8,000. Blue Note describes both musicians as New York-based and frames their shared language across jazz, hip-hop and electronic music; it also notes that they have collaborated previously. The venue expresses anticipation that unreleased material may appear, but no unreleased repertoire is treated as confirmed in this record.

Its reservation interface is session-based, so no generic booking URL is substituted as an event-specific purchase destination. No exact Apple Music destination is supplied in this batch.

en.why_it_matters: The duo format is the argument: drums facing keyboards and synthesizer with no bass player, horn or guitar to fill the middle. Yokley's rhythmic detail and BIGYUKI's ability to build bass, harmony and texture electronically leave the jazz/hip-hop/electronic overlap unusually exposed, making this a compact live test of how much architecture two players can create in real time.
en.trip_verdict: If Tokyo is already in play on September 29 and the evening is open, catch one of the two sets. It is a strong small-format Aoyama date to fit into a Kanto stay, but not one I would use by itself to reroute the trip.

es.why_it_matters: El argumento es el formato de dúo: batería frente a teclados y sintetizador, sin bajista, aliento o guitarra que rellene el centro. El detalle rítmico de Yokley y la capacidad de BIGYUKI para construir bajo, armonía y textura electrónicamente dejan muy expuesto el cruce entre jazz, hip-hop y electrónica; es una prueba compacta de cuánta arquitectura pueden levantar dos músicos en tiempo real.
es.trip_verdict: Si Tokio ya está en juego el 29 de septiembre y la noche está libre, entraría a uno de los dos sets. Es una fecha pequeña y muy buena para acomodar dentro de una estancia en Kanto, pero no la usaría por sí sola para desviar el viaje.
